item.title: FDA Releases Human Food Program 2026 Priorities
item.description: Priorities include reviewing food additives, reducing diet-related chronic disease through nutrition and preventing microbiological contamination in food.

item.title: Submissions Open for 3M's Middle School Science Competition
item.description: Previous challenge finalists and 3M scientists have collaborated to create solutions for a variety of real-world problems, including food safety.

item.title: Sweet Robo Unveils 3D Chocolate Printer
item.description: ChocoPrint enables on-demand printing of chocolate shapes, designs and custom logos.

item.title: USDA Announces New World Screwworm Grand Challenge
item.description: USDA’s Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) will invest up to $100 million to combat NWS and prevent its northward spread.

item.title: Kroger Shares 2026 Food Trend Predictions
item.description: Developed by Kroger's team of food experts, the trend predictions offer a forecast of what customers will be craving in 2026, including cultured dairy products and bold citrus flavors.

item.title: Wisconsin Cheese Makers Association Offers Student Scholarships
item.description: The Wisconsin Cheese Makers Association is offering $29,000 in scholarships to students interested in careers in the dairy industry.

item.title: FDA Releases Total Diet Study Interface
item.description: This new enhancement to FDA’s Total Diet Study surveillance program provides data to assess cumulative exposure to various contaminants in food.

item.title: Samples Collected by FDA Test Positive for C. Botulinum in ByHeart Infant Formula Investigation
item.description: Two samples collected by FDA have tested positive for Clostridium botulinum Type A: a ByHeart powdered infant formula closed product sample that matches a clinical isolate from an infant included in the outbreak, and an organic whole milk powder sample collected by FDA at a processor for a supplier to ByHeart.

item.title: Kiwa ASI Expands Canadian Presence with Addition of TSLC
item.description: TSLC is one of five approved licensed certification bodies for the CanadaGAP program, holding more than 30% market share, making them the second-largest certification body for CanadaGAP, Kiwa ASI said.

item.title: New Strain, More Illnesses Reported in Moringa Leaf Powder Salmonella Outbreak
item.description: FDA’s traceback investigation revealed a common manufacturer between Live it Up-brand Super Greens and Why Not Natural Pure Organic Moringa Green Superfood capsules that used moringa leaf powder in both products.
